devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: Let colleagues' laptops join this host over the tab-room network. Each device works with its role's permissions; the host stays the one source of truth. Nothing here needs the internet.
devices.noTournament: Open a tournament to manage devices.
devices.noPermission: Only the host owner and tab directors can manage devices.
devices.notListening: Devices cannot connect while this is off.
devices.noAddresses: This laptop has no network address. Connect it to the tab-room network.
devices.noCodes: No active code. A code works once, for 5 minutes.
devices.compareWords: Approve only if the device shows exactly the same six words in the same order. Different words mean someone may be in the middle: reject it.
devices.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? It is disconnected at once, cannot reconnect, and deletes its copy of the tournament when it next tries.
devices.successionHint: If this laptop dies, the first tab director in this list should be promoted to host. Every tab director's laptop keeps a full copy.
